name: call_entries
sql:
CREATE TABLE call_entries (
      call INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES calls(rowid),
      entry TEXT NOT NULL,
      role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('found', 'written', 'similar'))
    )

name: call_entries_entry
sql: CREATE INDEX call_entries_entry ON call_entries(entry, role)

name: calls
sql:
CREATE TABLE calls (
      rowid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      at TEXT NOT NULL,
      session_id TEXT,
      tool TEXT NOT NULL,
      slot TEXT,
      query TEXT,
      ok INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

name: calls_slot
sql: CREATE INDEX calls_slot ON calls(slot, tool)

name: entries
sql:
CREATE TABLE entries (
      rowid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      slot TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES slots(key),
      category TEXT NOT NULL,
      day TEXT NOT NULL,
      text TEXT NOT NULL
    )

name: entries_ad
entries_ai
entries_au
entries_fts
sql:
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE entries_fts
      USING fts5(text, content='entries', content_rowid='rowid', tokenize='trigram')

name: entries_fts_config
sql: CREATE TABLE 'entries_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

name: entries_fts_data
sql: CREATE TABLE 'entries_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

name: entries_fts_docsize
sql: CREATE TABLE 'entries_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

name: entries_fts_idx
sql: CREATE TABLE 'entries_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

name: entries_slot
sql: CREATE INDEX entries_slot ON entries(slot, category)

name: session_writes
sql:
CREATE TABLE session_writes (
      session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

name: slots
sql:
CREATE TABLE slots (
      key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      workspace TEXT,
      last_consolidated TEXT
    )
